fields.evidence: Adder bg3.exe+0x34144B0 allocates 8 bytes, writes 0 and returns the pointer; its only caller bg3.exe+0x3411500 (server stats reload of a character from its stats entry: resistances via eoc::ResistanceDataToEnum, a 7-element loop, ...) collects a 64-bit mask in a local (0x408 after resistances, |0x1000, |2 after the 7-element loop, |0x4000000) and stores it with *component = mask when non-zero. Read by the server StatsSystem (bg3.exe+0x31D6FB0, macOS esv::StatsSystem::Calculate*). Live: 0x1408 and 0x4001408, high dword 0.
